name: World Title
epitaph: WIA’s own top prize is never billed with a fuller name than “the World Title” anywhere in the surviving record, and no reign is ever recorded — the fed’s own January 2003 rankings name six of its ten ranked wrestlers as contenders headed into a “World Title Tourny,” but the tournament’s own bracket, matches, and outcome were never captured, and the ownership handover eleven days later never mentions it again. The belt is real, repeatedly and independently named by the fed’s own staff voice; who if anyone ever won it is not.
notes: Named six times in promotions/wia/archive/rankings-2003-01.html as “World Title” / “World Title Tourny” (Pyro, Steve Jackson, 8 Ball, Jerms, Spastic, Teal Shinto each named a contender or tournament entrant); no other held document names it.
